run_convert_regnet_to_mmdet: run the CLI tool to convert a pycls RegNet pretrained model to mmdet format
convert_regnet_model: convert keys in a pycls pretrained RegNet model to mmdet style and save the checkpoint
convert_stem_layers: convert stem convolution and batch norm layer keys from pycls to mmdet naming
convert_head_layers: convert head fully connected layer keys from pycls to mmdet naming
convert_reslayer_blocks: convert residual layer block keys including downsamples and conv/bn modules from pycls to mmdet
